question: Use Tables 4.1 and 4.2 to give the 2020 national, male and female probabilities of surviving to age five, and calculate the female–male difference in percentage points.
answer:
The 2020 national (Male + Female) probability of surviving to age five is 0.979. [p132-table-4.1]

The 2020 male probability of surviving to age five is 0.976. [p137-table-4.2]

The 2020 female probability of surviving to age five is 0.983. [p137-table-4.2]

The female-male difference in the 2020 probability of surviving to age five is 0.7 percentage points (0.983 - 0.976 = 0.007). [p137-table-4.2]
